gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-sc: Stark and uniform: Unica One draws every curve with room inside and no swelling at the corners. Noto Sans SC loosens things below, its chalky curves stopping short of closing.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-syloti-nag: Every stroke in Unica One keeps one constant width, and its curves leave clear gaps inside instead of closing up tight. Noto Sans Syloti Nagri adds short ascenders and a tall x-height beneath.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-syriac-wes: Distinctive from the first glance, Unica One holds a single line width throughout, with visible openings in every curve. Noto Sans Syriac Western keeps its terminals well away from the stroke body, so paragraphs read cleanly and breathe.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-tai-tham: Unica One is drawn in flat, single-weight lines with open curves, and it loses its punch once made small. Enlarge Noto Sans Tai Tham instead and its crowded chalk-board lowercase dominates.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-takri: Unica One keeps every joint where strokes meet free of thinning or bulging, which gives it a stamped, commanding look. Noto Sans Takri handles the quieter work, its round letters generously open.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-tangsa: Rope-like and commanding, Unica One lays its letters in fine, uniform strokes that hold their curves open. Noto Sans Tangsa softens it with wide, inviting round letters and short ascender stems.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-telugu: One unbroken line weight runs through Unica One, from terminal to junction, and the whole face feels commanding. Noto Sans Telugu then brings a high-set midline and counters that stay connected to the outside.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-thai: Single-weight and unmistakable, Unica One draws every curve open and carries a commanding stance. And Noto Sans Thai puffs out beneath it, an approachable lowercase swollen like inflated glass beads.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-thai-loope: Arch and stem match in the lowercase n of Unica One, and every other stroke keeps that single line weight. Beside it, Noto Sans Thai Looped feels tall and clean, with spacious curve ends.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-tifinagh: Rounded letters that stay open and inviting fill the line with bowls that look inflated. Noto Sans Tifinagh sits against Unica One, whose curves never thin, and that puffiness against rigid line is the draw.
